title: ThermoPhoton: Fast 3D Thermal Simulation of Photonic Integrated Circuits via Operator Learning
problem: Silicon photonic integrated circuits face severe thermal crosstalk at high density. Traditional numerical solvers prohibitively slow for large-scale 3D simulation. Existing ML surrogates lack generalization to distributed heaters and layered PIC structures.
motivation: Enable fast, accurate thermal-aware design of next-generation high-density photonic chips.
method: Operator-learning neural architecture (ThermoPhoton) tailored for PIC thermal modeling: pseudo-3D source representation leveraging device stratification; zero coordinate shift encoding for physics-informed loss; attention mechanisms capturing sharp thermal gradients and crosstalk effects.
key_novelty: Physics-informed operator learning with pseudo-3D representation and ZCS encoding for PIC thermal modeling.
contributions: Pseudo-3D source representation exploiting device stratification
Zero coordinate shift encoding for improved physics-informed loss
Attention-based operator learning capturing thermal gradients and crosstalk

metrics.other: 67.1% GPU memory reduction; 37.9% training time reduction vs prior operator methods

limitations: Validated on industry benchmarks; generalization to non-standard PIC structures or exotic materials unexplored.
primary_theme: fast thermal modeling for photonic chips
